text.p: Gateway 2000 Inc said its board authorized a two-for-one stock split to shareholders of record on June 2 with distribution expected to occur on or about June 16.
As of May 7, Gateway had about 77 million shares outstanding. After the split, the number will increase to about 154 million shares, it said.

The Gateway board also authorized a stock repurchase program under which the company may purchase up to 10 million shares (adjusted for stock split) of common stock in open market or negotiated transactions.
Shares repurchased will be available for issuance to employees under the company's stock-based employee benefit plans, the company said.
Finally, Gateway said that its common stock has been accepted for listing on the New York Stock Exchange and expects to begin trading on the Big Board under the new symbol GTW on May 22.
